subject: S5 accepted-1995 copied-client retries after correcting late accepted-Move attribution
scope: Four bounded original 1.16.5.0 client runs against isolated copied Auth/Game/DB with the private movement-trace DLL; ordinary movement and gate combat, no gameplay source or live Game/DIT changes. The character was restored to the same accepted-1995 baseline between runs.

timing_control.change: Private route readers now require accepted Move timestamp strictly after the latest hold command start, then 0.8 seconds without a newer row within a 4-second deadline. A row near the deadline without the quiet interval is reported as unsettled. Corpse movement checkpoints 13-15 also use the post-hold reader.
timing_control.verification: Deterministic replay of recorded D1/D400 command and row timestamps passes stale, missing, unsettled, and corpse-loc cases. The north-band retry produced real post-hold rows with 1.02 s and 0.85 s quiescence. This verifies the private reader on these traces; it does not verify final-live movement or the unfinished soldier interaction.
timing_control.limit: The private controller was revised between these runs; the final controller hash does not identify each earlier revision. The source manifests freeze command/result files, telemetry, screenshots and logs for each run.
timing_control.hash_scope: The final_private_controller_sha256 is historical at this record creation; see bootcamp-s5-corridor-fastprobe-retries-20260924.json for the later private controller hash.

runs.name: early_corridor_guard

runs.finding: Gate Thrax died by ordinary fire (copied XP 8766), and the accepted-1995 client reached (-65.28125,87.51953,75.33203) with near-full health. The controller's soldier branch required X -98..-88, so it stopped without soldier use. This earlier corridor point is close to the previously observed (-61.8,87.9,75.3); it does not demonstrate an interaction defect.

runs.exact_source: driver.log lines 'loc_accepted_move 06-near-outpost', 'settled_accepted_move 07-north-strafe-1', 'settled_accepted_move 08-north-forward-probe', and final RuntimeError; positions.tsv; objective state files
runs.finding: From (-89.890625,85.22266,72.80859), ordinary D800 reached (-92.92969,86.26172,76.35156) and W1000 reached (-95.74609,85.76172,72.828125). Both samples were after their hold commands and quiet for at least 0.8 s. The controller stopped before soldier targeting because X remained greater than -99; objective 1995/2 remained pending. The endpoint is close to an earlier successful north-strafe intermediate, suggesting a bounded D/W continuation, not proving it.

runs.name: north_fence_early_stop
runs.exact_source: driver.log lines 'loc_accepted_move 03-fence', 'loc_accepted_move 04-lower', 'loc_accepted_move 06-near-outpost', 'settled_accepted_move 06b-short-outpost-probe', and final RuntimeError; positions.tsv; objective state files
runs.finding: The copied client took the measured north fence branch, but its lower checkpoint was (-5.4101562,98.921875,134.7539), outside the prior west/south lower X branch. The private controller had incorrectly treated this accepted-Move X like ambiguous OCR and continued under a broad Y/Z guard. It later reached (-65.984375,87.51953,75.30859) near the outpost and W1800 ended at (-71.90625,87.46094,75.234375), outside the soldier branch; it stopped before any soldier or corpse interaction. The private controller now fails closed at the earlier lower/approach X guards. These route variants are copied-client observations, not final-live positions.
